description: Dubbed Rizal’s Mona Lisa, Josephine Sleeping was molded in Dapitan, personally signed by Rizal. In 2024, the National Museum of the Philippines acquired the statuette, which is currently exhibited in the Spoliarium Gallery.

images.alt: Pale reclining figure of a sleeping woman wrapped in drapery, modelled in the round

author: Nicole Lasquety

model3d.altText: Interactive 3D model of Rizal's Josephine Sleeping, the reclining figure free to rotate and zoom
model3d.credit: 3D model: photogrammetry by the National Museum of the Philippines
